title: Jazz in San Francisco when the Oliver band arrived
summary: Asked about jazz on the coast, Garland says nobody played it and Oliver's band was the best around, at a San Francisco place.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Creole Cafe. When you came to the west coast, did they know about jazz here, did they? No.
Were you one of the first bands? Yeah, I didn't know about no jazz.
Were there any other people who were playing that kind of music?
No. Still, the Prod and them had the best band around there at the right time. That was at, uh, Leicester Mapp's place.
Was that in the city of San Francisco?
